lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in loose vertical columns of approximately 4-5 units each, extending from the post-gill region towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary lateral spots, creating a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-luminance upper edges to shaded lower edges, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7-9 distinct high-intensity blobs are distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, showing a lower density compared to the anterior head region.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of minute, uniform high-luminance spots, significantly smaller in diameter than the spots on the primary lateral flank.
